title.en: Absolute Pressure: Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump keeps Name fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm
title.zh: 绝对压力：电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60保留「是 35 m³/h。」

description.en: Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump. Name fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm Electric 60 is 90 kW and 40 m³/h
description.zh: 电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60见 /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump。是 35 m³/h。点明细石、13 mm 或 24 mm。

h1.en: Gauge Pressure is the heading; Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「表压」，主体仍是电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump. Name fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm. Electric 60 is 90 kW and 40 m³/h. The frame is 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. Diesel 60 is 144 kW diesel and 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. It is the printed label beside 75 kW on this low-pressure page. Write 75 kW and the path /en/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h and hopper 0.7 m³ on a 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm frame. Put Electric 75-60 or the low-pressure path in the inquiry so the 75 kW cell is the one quoted. On the Electric Low Pressure 60 page, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the model as Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60, motor 75 kW, theoretical output 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.5 m³, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 100 m / 300 m and 24 mm stone 80 m / 240 m. The section title “Absolute Pressure” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump。是 35 m³/h。点明细石、13 mm 或 24 mm。电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h。它是这一低压页上、75 kW 旁边的印刷标注。外形 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm，重量 3500 kg。柴油60是 144 kW 柴油机，外形 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。询盘里写 Electric 75-60 或低压路径，这样报价对着的才是 75 kW。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、料斗 0.7 m³，外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。写上 75 kW 和路径 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/。在电动低压60页上，河北品锦机械（邢台）把型号印成电动低压60 / Electric 75-60，电机 75 kW，理论输送量 35 m³/h，30 MPa，料斗 0.5 m³，细石 150 m / 350 m，13 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m，24 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m。节标题「绝对压力」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: This section is titled “Absolute Pressure”. Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Name fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm. It is the printed label beside 75 kW on this low-pressure page. On the Electric Low Pressure 60 page, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the model as Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60, motor 75 kW, theoretical output 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.5 m³, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 100 m / 300 m and 24 mm stone 80 m / 240 m.
body.zh: 本节标题是「绝对压力」。电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60下面这些格子仍是印出来的。点明细石、13 mm 或 24 mm。询盘里写 Electric 75-60 或低压路径，这样报价对着的才是 75 kW。是 35 m³/h。

body.en: Under “Gauge Pressure”, Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Electric 60 is 90 kW and 40 m³/h. Write 75 kW and the path /en/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/.
body.zh: 在「表压」下，电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60这一节只放已印出的格子。电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h。在电动低压60页上，河北品锦机械（邢台）把型号印成电动低压60 / Electric 75-60，电机 75 kW，理论输送量 35 m³/h，30 MPa，料斗 0.5 m³，细石 150 m / 350 m，13 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m，24 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m。它是这一低压页上、75 kW 旁边的印刷标注。

body.en: “Atmospheric Pressure” titles this part of the Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. The frame is 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h and hopper 0.7 m³ on a 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm frame.
body.zh: 「大气压力」是电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。外形 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm，重量 3500 kg。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、料斗 0.7 m³，外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。

body.en: For Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump, the heading “Pressure Units” does not replace a cell. Diesel 60 is 144 kW diesel and 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Put Electric 75-60 or the low-pressure path in the inquiry so the 75 kW cell is the one quoted. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pressure-d_587.html.
body.zh: 对电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60而言，标题「压力单位」并不替换任何格子。柴油60是 144 kW 柴油机，外形 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。写上 75 kW 和路径 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pressure-d_587.html。

question.en: Does “Absolute Pressure” replace Name fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm?

answer.en: No. Name fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm remains the printed wording for Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。是 35 m³/h。仍是电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Electric 60 is 90 kW and 40 m³/h belong on the Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60这一行里，「点明细石、13 mm 或 24 mm。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Gauge Pressure” add to Electric LOW Pressure 60 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「表压」给电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pressure-d_587.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pressure-d_587.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
